audit.whatIsWrong: The packet flags that this page never names a single Heimerdinger ability, and it is right: the content layer says 'his turret', 'W rockets' and 'the E grenade' throughout, while the full layer invents 'CH-2 Grenade (Stun)'. Nothing explains WHY levels 1-2 are his beyond 'out-range and out-poke'.
audit.why: The real names are H-28 G Evolution Turret, Hextech Micro-Rockets, CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade, UPGRADE!!! and Hextech Affinity. And the range gap is the whole stage: Micro-Rockets reach 1325 against your 850 Noxious Blast — a 475-unit deficit you cannot close with a poke war, which is exactly why the opener and the late game read Heimerdinger.
audit.corrected: Real names used in both layers, and the 1325-vs-850 gap written into the level 1-2 spike, whys[0], the key-interactions slot and the loading tip.

audit.whatIsWrong: Not one cooldown appears in either layer despite six lines telling you to commit "on its cooldown".
audit.why: CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade is a flat 11s at 970 range, Hextech Micro-Rockets 11/10/9/8/7s at 1325, UPGRADE!!! 100/85/70s, and the turret redeploys on a 1s cast. Your Miasma is 24s, so you get roughly one grounding per two grenades.
audit.corrected: 11s, 1325, 970, 100s and your own 24s written into the cooldown block, the trigger card, the mid text and the wants list.

audit.whatIsWrong: Every line treats the grenade as a flat stun — 'The stun makes his turret nest lethal' — and nothing distinguishes a direct hit from a graze.
audit.why: Riot's text: 'lobs a grenade at a location, dealing damage to enemy units, as well as stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units.' Only a direct hit stuns; the surrounding radius merely slows. That single distinction turns an unavoidable stun into a sidestep, and it is the difference between diving the nest and dying in it. Separately, Hextech Affinity gives him move speed near his own turrets, so he kites better inside the nest than outside it.
audit.corrected: Direct-hit-versus-graze written into the win condition, the trigger card, the key-interactions slot, the level-6 spike and the mid text; Hextech Affinity named so the nest's speed bonus is not a surprise.

edits.before: Level 1-2 is his — his turret plus W rockets out-range and out-poke my single Q, and I have no Q/W poison stacked yet to trade back. I farm with the tip of Q and eat a little chip rather than walking into the nest. The lane swings the moment I have Q and E together at 3: I throw Q across both him and his turrets, then Twin Fang whatever's poisoned, and the Q move-speed buff lets me peel out of rocket range before his grenade lands. Dodge the E — it's slow and telegraphed, and if I sidestep it his only follow-up is turret autos.
edits.after: Levels 1-2 are his — the H-28 G turret plus Hextech Micro-Rockets reach 1325 against my 850 Noxious Blast, and I have no poison stacked to trade back. I farm with the tip of Q and eat a little chip rather than walking into the nest. The lane swings the moment I have Q and E together at 3: I throw Q across both him and his turrets, then Twin Fang whatever is poisoned, and the Q move-speed buff carries me out of rocket range. Dodge the CH-2 Electron Storm Grenade — only a direct hit stuns, so clipping its edge costs me a slow and nothing more.

edits.before: This is my window. With ranks in Q and E I chain near-continuous Twin Fangs on a poisoned Heimer, and my W slow-and-ground locks him in place so he can't Flash or walk out while I shred — just don't expect W to remove his turrets, it grounds champions, not the nest. He out-pokes me at rest, so I don't sit in rockets; I commit only when Q has tagged him and his E grenade is on cooldown. At 6, Petrifying Gaze is my catch: bait the grenade, then R while he's facing me and walk him down through turret fire on my passive move speed. The whole fight is winning the grenade timing.
edits.after: This is my window. With ranks in Q and E I chain near-continuous Twin Fangs on a poisoned Heimer, and my W slow-and-ground holds him while I shred — but W grounds champions, not turrets, so it never clears the nest. He out-pokes me at rest from 1325, so I commit only once Q has tagged him and the Electron Storm Grenade's 11s is ticking. Remember Hextech Affinity speeds him up inside his own nest. At 6, bait the grenade, then R while he faces me and walk him down on my passive move speed. The whole fight is the grenade timing.

edits.before: Late, this tilts back toward him. Heimer becomes a siege and pick monster — a fresh turret nest plus an R-empowered E grenade can stun and delete squishy me before my Twin Fang ramps, and with no boots and no resistances I can't survive the burst. I'm still the better raw single-target DPS if I reach him uninterrupted, but his whole kit exists to make sure I never do. I look for flanks where I can W-ground his escape and R him off the nest, and I let my team eat the turret aggro so I'm not the one walking into the wall.
edits.after: Late, this tilts back toward him. Heimerdinger becomes a siege and pick monster — a fresh nest plus an UPGRADE!!!-empowered Electron Storm Grenade off a 100s ultimate can stun and delete squishy me before Twin Fang ramps, and with no boots and no resistances I cannot survive the burst. I am still the better raw single-target DPS if I reach him uninterrupted, but his whole kit exists so I never do. I look for flanks where I can W-ground his escape and R him off the nest, and let my team eat the turret aggro.

notes: Twin Fang can be spent on his turrets, but nothing in the local files establishes whether Noxious Blast's poison applies to them and therefore whether Twin Fang gets its bonus damage and refund off a turret — so no line claims turret-clearing with E. Also unverified and left out: whether Miasma's grounding stops a Flash (the old wants.you[1] said 'dash/Flash out'; I left that slot untouched rather than assert it). Twin Fang's derived 'projectile' flag contradicts its targeted description and nothing here relies on it.
